AThe safety guarantees, demonstrated

5An unverified message never acts
HTTP 401 before the payload is read.
$ # replay an envelope whose payload was
$ # altered after it was signed
$ curl -X POST localhost:8000/api/aria/receive \
      -d @tampered.json

{
  "detail": "Signature does not match the envelope contents."
}
HTTP 401

  The rule engine is never reached. The
  rejection is written to audit_log as
  aria.verification.failed with the reason.
6Five audit entries per authorization
Every decision row carries its rule ID.
$ curl -s localhost:8000/api/audit/$ID

  auth_request.created       provider/metro-valley
  aria.auth_request.sent     provider/metro-valley
  aria.auth_request.received payer/meridian
  decision.rendered          payer/meridian
  aria.auth_response.sent    payer/meridian

  decision.rendered, before -> after:
    status:      pending    -> approved
    rule_id:     None       -> PAVO-R002
    confidence:  None       -> 1.0
7A zero-knowledge proof of patient criteria
Three criteria proven. Age, diagnosis and deductible appear nowhere in the response.
$ curl -s -X POST localhost:8000/api/zk/generate \
    -d '{"patient_age":42,"diagnosis_code":"M17.11","deductible_met":true}'

{
  "proof_id": "e8e370b4-7dbc-45d3-8b79-abae8961799d",
  "public_signals": [
    "1",
    "1",
    "1",
    "18",
    "196730042053713158391225580434902024231",
    "1"
  ],
  "proof_digest": "sha256:cd2df83a6fe4b231b44e9c223eb88f75747566288720570977ab893ef175eda6",
  "claims": {
    "age_valid": true,
    "diagnosis_valid": true,
    "deductible_valid": true,
    "min_age": "18",
    "deductible_required": true
  },
  "criteria": {
    "min_age": "18",
    "approved_diagnosis_hash": "196730042053713158391225580434902024231",
    "deductible_required": "1",
    "circuit": "patient_criteria",
    "protocol": "groth16"
  },
  "proof": "<groth16 pi_a / pi_b / pi_c - 8 field elements, elided>"
}

  NOTE: patient_age, diagnosis_code and deductible_met appear
        nowhere in this response. Only the three verdicts do.
What this response does and does not reveal The six public signals are three verdicts (1,1,1) and the three policy parameters the payer set (min_age 18, the approved-diagnosis hash, deductible_required 1). The patient's actual age, diagnosis code and deductible balance are never transmitted. The one thing it does leak, stated in §5.3 of the report: because the diagnosis check compares against a single hash, a passing proof tells the payer the patient carries that one diagnosis.

9aThe audit trail — 74 events, filterable, exportable
Append-only. Nothing on this screen is editable.
What to notice in the requests table Every row carries a rule ID and 100% confidence — 100% because the match is definitive, not because a model was sure. No language model participates in any decision on that screen. The one Escalated row is PAVO-R003: a knee replacement whose diagnosis did not match the covered condition, waiting for a human with its record already assembled.
